title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES RENAMING THE COMMISSION ON POPULATION AS THE COMMISSION ON POPULATION AND DEVELOPMENT AND REVERTING ITS ATTACHMENT TO THE NATIONAL ECONOMIC AND DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES

text.en:
Renaming and Attachment. The Commission on Population shall
be renamed as the "Commission on Population and Development" (CPD). Its attachment
shall be reverted to the NEDA for policy and program coordination.

The Executive Director. In accordance with Section 10 of PD No.
79, as amended, an Executive Director (ED) shall be appointed by the CPD Chairperson,
subject to the approval of the CPD Board of Commissioners (Board). The ED, who shall
receive the emoluments attached to the rank of an undersecretary, shall provide technical
and administrative services to the CPD Board in accordance with the powers and duties
of the ED under PD No. 79, as amended.

Funding. The budget necessary for the implementation of this Order
shall be sourced from available funds of the CPD for FY 2018. For the succeeding years,
the funding requirements of the CPD shall be included in its budget proposal which shall
be submitted to the DBM, subject to the budgetary process.

Repeal. All executive orders, rules and regulations, and other
issuances or parts thereof which are inconsistent with this Order are hereby revoked,
amended or modified accordingly.

Separability. If any provision of this Order is declared invalid or
unconstitutional, the other provisions not affected thereby shall remain valid and
subsisting.

Effectivity. - This Order shall take effect upon its publication in the
Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 13t lay of December in the year of Our Lord,
Two Thousand and Eighteen.
By the President:
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
Executive Secretary
Office of the President
